news.title: Price target decreased by 8.2% to ₹717
news.body: Down from ₹781, the current price target is an average from 2 analysts. New target price is 37% above last closing price of ₹525. Stock is down 2.4% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹30.55 for next year compared to ₹30.20 last year.

news.title: New major risk - Financial position
news.body: The company's debt is not well covered by operating cash flow. Currently running at an operating cash loss. This is considered a major risk. If the company's operating cash flows are too small relative to the size of their debt, it increases their balance sheet risk. The company has less cash from operations to cover its expenses from servicing large debt and it increases the risk of liquidity issues. It also extends the time it would take for the company to pay back the debt in full, meaning it may not be able to easily pay it all off in a distress scenario. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (currently running at an operating cash loss). High level of non-cash earnings (45% accrual ratio).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹30.20 (up from ₹17.10 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹108.3b (up 41% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹4.10b (up 88% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 3.8% (up from 2.8% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 10%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 1.3%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Specialty Retail industry in India.

news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 21%

news.title: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited Appoints Deepak Kumar Vijay as Chief Financial Officer Effective January 24, 2026
news.body: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited appointed Mr. Deepak Kumar Vijay as Chief Financial Officer (Key Managerial Personnel) effective January 24, 2026. Deepak Vijay is an accomplished finance leader with over 18 years of cross-industry experience across apparel sourcing, retail, manufacturing, and hospitality sectors. He is a Chartered Accountant with executive education from IIM Ahmedabad and has completed CFA Level II. Over the course of his career, he has held senior and leadership roles with globally respected organizations including Techno Design (subsidiary of PDS Limited), Marks & Spencer (India – JV with Reliance Retail), Fossil Group, and IHCL (Taj Hotels).
